notes.title: April Fools Update: The Zombie Heist
notes.notes:
Happy 1st of April (or rather, the day after, because I had to make sure stuff didn't breakːmissingː)

Do your best and rob the bank!

[h1]Custom GameMode: Zombie Heist[/h1]
This gamemode only has 1 map, since it was simply created for this event gamemode. Once the event is over, it will be moved over to Workshop, so it won't stick around for too long :)

You can access this gamemode by going into [b]Host Game > Campaign > Select a session > Zombie Heist[/b]. You can also run the map by writing "map hst_bank" in the console.

The premise is pretty simple, you pick your class and equipment and rob the bank. The escape vehicle will be available once you hit 1m (1 million) in total cash. The round will restart once everyone has escaped.



All right, now that's over with- let's go over what's new on this update!

[h3]Custom GameMode Support[/h3]
Contagion now supports custom gamemode candidates, which means anybody can now create their own gamemode using Angelscript!

Even though this may be an April fools update, it not only contains the "haha, stupid gamemode joke", it does come with many changes and tweaks! And a little tease towards the Barlowe Remake campaign that's nearly complete. The goal is to have it ready by May or June (if I need a little more time)!

Anyho, here is the little changelog for today's update!
[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]*[/b]Added Patreon and Ko-fi Rewards (and credits, can be found under Extras)
[*]Added new survivor models `military01` and `military02`

[*]Added Angelscript support for the Client. You can now have custom ingame UI
[*]Added Glow support for `OutlineItem` MaterialProxy, to make sure custom assets are still supported.
[*]Added red glow for dead players, if you have a defibrillator.
[*]Added Client-side Angelscript functions:

[/list]
[*]Added Server-side Angelscript functions:

[*]Added "void GetAttachment(const string &in strAttachment, Vector &out vecOrigin, Vector &out vecForward, Vector &out vecRight, Vector &out vecUp )"
[*]Added "void CBaseEntity.FireOutput( const string &in szInput, const float &in flDelay, CBaseEntity @pActivator, CBaseEntity @pCaller )"

[b]*[/b]About Patreon / Ko-Fi Rewards:
If you have supported via Patreon and/or Ko-Fi and don't have your rewards, please make sure to send me a Direct Message (DM) via said platform with your SteamID (or the direct link to your Steam Profile if you don't know how to obtain your Public SteamID), so I can give you your [b]**[/b]rewards.

notes.title: Major Update: 2.2.0.0
notes.notes:
It's been awhile, hasn't it?

This update brings out a new overhauled UI, a party system, and updated Flatline and much more! You can find the detailed changes on the changelog.


[h2]The New UI[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/b6b84e23bff63f20f66eded4ea22dedbf75d37e7.jpg[/img]
The UI has been re-written from ground up. And not only that, the old lobby system has been fully scrapped and been replaced by this new party system (max 8 members). With this new party system, the party leader who creates a lobby game (Peer-2-Peer / Reservation) or by simply joining a dedicated server, those on your party will also automatically join if they are not already in a game.


[h2]Language Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/2e3927891bf90520e67487408e0c417671f85034.png[/img]
You can now change the Language of the game from the Options to any of the available languages. By default it uses the same language as your Steam application, but will revert to English if said language is not support and/or does not exist.


[h2]Attachment System Updated[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/9bdda4c54a04d037d7dde9ab46465bc0e4b8db9f.jpg[/img]
You can now drop attachments that you don't like and/or want. After being dropped, the attachment can only be picked up by the player that dropped it for 30 seconds. But do remember that some weapons does not support any kind attachments, or said attachment.


[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h3]Engine[/h3]

Contagion now supports Angelscript, a new alternative to vscript.

Angelscript supports both map and plugin related scripts. It also supports object manipulation, such as changing an entity mid game, or creating a door in the air, because why not.

You can read up the api docs here: [url=https://ohne-reue.de/ContagionApi/]Contagion AS API[/url]

notes.title: July Update: 2.1.4.3
notes.notes:
The last 32-bit update is here! A lot of things got crammed into this update, since most of the fixes was actually supposed to ship last month in June, but as we all know, that did not happen.

[h2]Console UI & Classic HUD[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/3ff7202a43f00ecf9e4b5e6fbc1045dfcfd070a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/037e2955d69114a287ef59c403e43a7ab656afba.jpg[/img]
Controller support has now been added as a new startup parameter called "--controller_mode", this will tell the engine to utilise the new controller format and UI that has been specially designed for controllers.

Only Xbox360 controllers are supported as of now, since I do not own a PS4, or any other controller. You can however modify the prompts by writing "--controller ps4", but you will be required to create the new icons manually. The icons are found under materials/vgui/controller/.

Console UI uses Classic HUD by default, but can be enabled on the PC UI by going into Options > Multiplayer. It can also be turned on by writing "hud_classic 1" in the console.


[h2]Random Weapon Attachments[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/9bb6ce0a2b3f50eb58fa4655df686383a4f46bbb.jpg[/img]
Random weapon attachments that got teased before are now here! This will give the weapons some breath of fresh air, since the weapon will automatically randomise what kind of attachment it will spawn with.

Even the starter weapon, the Sig Saur, will either have a flashlight, silencer, maybe both, or nothing at all. This does not apply to normal and easy difficulty however.


[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
The next thing that I will focus on is 64-bit. It is mostly done, but was put on hold to finish this update. Now that this update is finally done, I will now focus on finishing up the Engine to properly support 64-bit, after that, It's just matter of time of porting the game code over to the new 64-bit version of the engine.

This will take awhile to complete, so don't expect any major updates for quite awhile. But once 64-bit is complete, expect some big new improvements for Contagion! Some really exiting things are on the horizon.

The crash dumps can be found at a new folder called "crashdumps" that gets generated on server / game boot where the executable is located at.

notes.title: May Update: 2.1.4.0
notes.notes:
The May Update is finally here! It contains 1 new Flatline map, bug fixes as always, and some new minor additions!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/ab68461d18f63cb50ed66920fe28fab5568db675.jpg[/img]
[b]Clock Tower[/b] is a new Flatline map I have created. The map has only 5 waves, instead of the usual 10, however, the map itself increases its difficulty drastically per wave. This map also utilises the new entities I have created to make it easier to create new maps for Flatline gamemode.

I would love to create more maps, but there is only so much I can do alone.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/eb1e5f5fe9746d8c042fb809d7ff338b55893a27.png[/img]
Now, about the "Create Game (Legacy)" that was added, it is a re-written Legacy styled server creation window for local games (port forwarding required). It contains more configuration options than the L4D2 UI one under "Create Game". L4D2 one is more cramped, and shares code with the "Find Game" one, which is why this was created.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/82f6c429c33995d4aad551017e163691af6b6fd6.png[/img]
Server Browser has also been updated, and tweaked. It was missing some features that is present in SDK 2013 branch, which is adjusting its size (if the server browser generated config file is missing) when drawing the dialog for the first time. This has been fixed, as well as the server columns having faulty widths and font sizes.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/537712b1c84af4ffa3ac02f7e70b04cdaaf93322.jpg[/img]
Vote System has been added, and can be toggled on or off. It's pretty straight forward, and simple as of now, but can be expanded and improved upon.
Here are the available commands for the system:
[code]
convar: sv_allow_votes
default: 1
desc: Enables Vote System

convar: sv_vote_issue_kick_allowed
default: 1
desc: Allow Vote kick players (Can not vote kick moderators, nor administrators)

convar: sv_vote_kick_ban_duration
default: 5
desc: How long should a kick vote ban someone from the server? (in minutes)

convar: sv_vote_issue_change_difficulty_allowed
default: 1
convar: Allow Vote for a new difficulty (Applied on the next round)

convar: sv_vote_issue_restart_game_allowed
default: 1
convar: Allow Vote for round restart
[/code]

notes.title: March Update: 2.1.3.0
notes.notes:
Another month, another update! It's not as large, or big, as the previous update, since I had to scale down on the update due to [i]unforeseen consequences[/i].

For those who wanted a Linux Dedicated Server for Contagion, I got some bad news, it's on hold until further notice. Reasons that are out of my control, and there isn't anything I can do about it for the time being.

The AI has been improved and updated. Most of the new changes is for the BOT AI, to make them enjoyable to fight against on Hunted and Panic! Classic gamemodes. They are still quite dumb when it comes to Objective oriented gamemodes (such as Escape, Extraction and Panic! Objective). They will be further improved upon so they will work properly on all gamemodes as well, so that they are able to help out the player(s).

The translations has also been moved to their own respective folder, instead of using the "resource" folder. They are now located under "translations", to make it easier to find, modify and/or create new translations for the game. To test your translation, launch the game with the startup paramater "[b]-lang[/b]" (Example: [b]-lang japanese[/b]). You can find the translations within the vpk file "translations_dir" under vpks folder.

I hope everyone will enjoy this month's update!

notes.title: February Update: 2.1.2.0
notes.notes:
Another large update!

I've been doing my best fixing and balancing things that was either broken or OP. Some new additions has also been added, such as "Nightmare" difficulty, for those who are up for the challenge.

Flatline has been updated, such as the "Mystery Box", and the new "Trap" items. The "Mystery Box" will always grant a weapon with a random upgrade, such as double damage for example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/04c0cdb900d7385922135358838a90e7a8b4b694.jpg[/img]

The survivor AI has also been updated, they no longer get stuck on ladders and will now drop their weapon if they run out of ammo, and get scared if the zombie attacks them if they have no weapon.

Extraction has been tweaked, it no longer starts the horde right away when you reach the hold out position, so now you will have time to board up and loot the location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/8576f9b95e15113100ad89a6750d6a6de039bd74.jpg[/img]

Infected AI can now also grapple survivors, however, this only applies to Hard and higher difficulties. Just like the player grapple, it will infect the players if infection is enabled. And will deal a great deal amount of damage, so double check your surroundings when playing on Hard or higher difficulties.

Steam Workshop has also been updated to UGC format, instead of using the old Legacy which utilized Steam Cloud. With this new changes, clients will be able to download UGC directly when trying to join a server that uses a map from the Steam Workshop. Older Legacy content does not support this feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/844248f06bf2e23a07cbfb6e4cead8c8a092039a.jpg[/img]

The Inoculator is back! This time, however, it acts differently than it did in the KS and Early Access builds, since the First Aid kit has taken it's role. The inoculator this time around cures the infection, however, on Hard and higher, it only delays the infection. It also grants 25% health, so it can also be used as a health item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/16376edba1374d052d04e1b0a5103329e502b3d8.jpg[/img]

2 New zombie "types" has been added, which is the "doctors" and "looters". The doctors can drop a first aid kit, or a inoculator, however, the drop chance decreases on each difficulty. The looters act similar to the "fallen survivor" from Left 4 Dead, which is where this type is inspired from. They will randomly drop ammo, or an explosive. Just like the doctors, their drop rate gets less the harder difficulty you play on.

I hope everyone will enjoy this update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/3ad5528329e7342ac166889006cd2f3b9971ba40.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 2.1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This one large update contains the long awaited [b]Lobby System[/b]! The lobby uses the [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/features/multiplayer/networking]Steam Networking features[/url], which means you do not need to port forward your ports when using it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/a0b60d8609c0d4de070979db4692bc97bf0010d1.jpg[/img]

I have also tweaked Flatline some more, and adjusted the shop prices a bit, and added some quality of life features to Contagion, such as updating the Survivor AI. Some nasty server related issues has also been dealt with, such as getting "Host_Error" crashes, when it should just kick the player back to the Main Menu. Or if the map is missing, and the client would just crash down due to "texture information" being invalid, instead of showing "Map Missing".

A new Flatline map has also been added. This version of Stone Creek, is Christmas themed. It's a bit late, but never the less, it's a new change of scenery. Xmas version of Stone Creek was available back in 2013 and 2014, before it was changed back to the original theme.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4734227/f35c722be33cc98637da5585eae49694580fff25.jpg[/img]

Oh, and for the modders out there, I have included the official SMD compile files for survivors and weapons, so you can create custom content easier.

Workshop will also get a overhaul at a later time. At this moment, Workshop uses Steam Cloud, instead of [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/features/workshop]SteamUGC[/url]. Once this change happens, clients will be able to download the workshop map & it's content when connecting to the server. The client will of course, be able to turn it off if they don't want to download workshop content from the servers. Old workshop content using Steam Cloud method will not be affected, however, they will be required to be updated to SteamUGC format to be able to be downloaded when joining the server, if content is missing.

You can read the whole changelog below!

notes.title: Contagion Major Update! -- 2.1.0.0
notes.notes:
[b]We hope everyone will enjoy this meaty update![/b]

This major update revision to Contagion may break some old WWise audiobanks, if your map uses custom audiobanks. The reason is due we have updated WWise to fix some memory problems that the old version had.
We have also fixed the infamous shader crash, and split 2 maps in half because of memory shortage problems.

And we have finally completed Flatline! It's no longer in Beta, but that doesn't mean we are done with it. More changes and additions will be added later down the road!

More interesting things will come in the future! ːGoBoomː

The 10th Anniversary announcement will be posted later today, so expect some more news to come!

[b]***[/b]The maps have also been connected together, which is why the trigger entity logic_safezone was created. It works similar, if not almost the same, as the safe room in L4D and L4D2. ----

Other updates:
Now before folks start asking for patches, I am not a dev, I am a Community Manager. I have no Coding/Programming knowledge. I have had to learn how to work through the servers and how to upload the mods. Phew...

I need to let you guys know right now:
-New content will be unlikely.
-Bug fixes will happen if we can gather enough resources from Outbreak's PSVR launch to hire a Source engine coder. Somewhere between End 2018/Start 2019 Ish.
-No new languages are planned to be added.
-More mods may be tested and added if we recieve many requests.
----

Griefing, reporting, harassment:
-There has been a lot of reports, I am taking all reports in discord add me(Mike) through there and PM me screenshots/footage. (https://discord.gg/monochrome) Though I can't permaban for people disliking each other.

---If you feel as if your life is in immediate danger, please call the police, and pm me anything of others threatening your life, locating your address, threatening to expose your credentials, etc. That is a permaban offense.---

As much as some might claim, we can't outright ban people unless of the above^  Only temp ban. We hate resorting to bans. With that said, I will do what I can, to open up a server with passwords and on the discord so players can join with other non griefing, non bullying players. And if one sneaks in to troll, I can server kick.

|||||Please respect other players|||||
If you come to a disagreement with another player, best to not further argue and just mute each other. Not everyone is meant to get along and that’s fine. Rule of thumb, if you no longer have anything nice to say, then keep it to yourself, or move along.

Do not take advantage of exploits and toss keys in irretrievable areas, camp exploited areas, etc. on Official servers.

If you do want to, do it on your own private server. Have at it there. If you report a griefer on their own private server, it will be overlooked and you will be asked to stay on official servers or rent your own.
----

With that said, let me know what mods you would like me to test out. :)

-Mike

notes.title: "So WTF is going on" Update
notes.notes:
So, real quick. We haven't forgotten about Contagion. However, Outbreak is releasing next month, so it's been quite busy and all of the attention has been on it.

A few months back, I did have a little bit of time on my hands and actually tried to update the game. However, I ran into some issues and was unsuccessful.ːsteamfacepalmː 

We got ahold of the original programmer to get his workflow and see if there was something I was doing wrong, but we couldn't figure it out at the time (also, he had been out of the game for awhile).ːsteamsadː

You can watch dev streaming of Outbreak through Twitch or YouTubeːsteamhappyː:

https://www.twitch.tv/victorburgosgames

or

https://www.youtube.com/victorburgosgames


Also, every once in awhile during streams I will be providing Contagion keys, so if you don't have one, jump in and chat. If you do, grab one for a friend.

Once things slow down for Outbreak, we'll go ahead and take another crack at updating Contagion. Sadly, we don't have anyone dedicated (and really can't afford it right now) to OG Contagion. 

I just realized that my head has been down in the sand (I rarely have any spare time) and it's been 4 months since the last update. Time flies. I know you've probably heard this song and dance before but I know from the bottom of my heart that we wish we could clone ourselves and work on both games at the same time. But we can't ːsteamsadː


[h1]Post Responses[/h1]

9/21 - Haven't been on here for awhile. I was [b]NOT[/b] on the original Contagion dev team. I was brought on for Contagion VR: Outbreak, and that's it. So is everyone else on the team. 

The fact that I was planning on doing something in my [i]FREE[/i] spare time to get this thing back on track, was just that...a plan. Source Engine is old as hell, like so old... I am an Unreal Engine 4 developer first and foremost. 

So, yeah, plan failed. I am very open and honest, so I tell it how it is. 

Many of you don't understand game development or programming, and as a consumer you don't have to. 

You all have the right to be mad that the game was not maintained after awhile. No one is trying to take that away from you all. 

Just have some patience and empathy. All I am asking.

notes.title: Workshop update live now!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/Contagion_Store_Announcement_Preview.png[/img]

As many of you know our new team member Pablo has been hard at work deep in the Contagion code. Well today I am pleased to announce that the first of many new update's for Contagion is now live. 

[h1]This update includes several fixes on the Workshop side of things:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The 100 MB cap for mods has been removed. Mods are now only limited in size to what storage space the creator has avalible on their Steam cloud. 
[*] Tags have been fixed to allow proper filtering in Steam.
[/list]

As I said there are more updates in the works and will be happy to announce those when they are ready. Pablo wanted to share with all of you what updates will be coming in the future.

[list]
[h1]Log files[/h1]
[*]Purpose: Giving the user the option of sending a file with the problem that they are having. This reduces time in investigating and fixing the bug.

[h1]Translation to different languages[/h1]
[*]Purpose: Making the life easier to non-english players.
 
[h1]Fix mod modification[/h1]
[*]Purpose: Sometimes, when attempting to modify an existing mod, the error "you have not selected a file" displays. This fix would resolve this issue.

[h1]Add functionality to inform the user of how much space he/she wil have
remaining after the mod is uploaded[/h1]
[*]Purpose: This allows the user to be better informed of cloud storage limitations.

[h1]Add additional tags[/h1]
[*]Purpose: More tags.

[h1]Provide a default image in mod creation and provide a warning that "The upload will not stop due to lack of an image' if the use has not provided an image[/h1]
[*]Purpose: Does not restrict mod upload due to lack of an image.
 
[h1]Provide an percentage status of the upload[/h1]
[*]Purpose: This allows the user to be aware of the upload progress.
[/list]

This is only some of of the updates in the works. Many more updates are on their way and I will share what information I can when it is provided to me.

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion Update for the new year!
notes.notes:
[h1]Contagion Update out! Now with 100% less holiday cheer![/h1]

I don't know about you guys, but I used to be terrible at taking my Christmas tree down. It would stick around until it became a bona fide fire hazard. But eventually, it found it's way to the curb, and a nice man would come and take it away to the [strike]Old Christmas Trees Home[/strike].

Anyway, now we have a plastic Christmas tree and we promptly put it away after it's all said and done. I don't know what the moral of that story is, but the new update is out and all our old, out of season holiday decorations have been stowed safely away before they get the chance to burn the joint down. The old maps are back to their gritty, zombie bitten selves and the zombies are no longer as cheerful as they once were.

[strike]The official servers will be updated shortly; the patch will be out before they are updated, but we'll try to keep the downtime to a minimum.[/strike] [b]The servers should now all be up and running with the latest patch![/b]

The changelog is short and sweet, but here it is:

-Removed Holiday content
-Removed Holiday option from multiplayer menu
-Bugfix in ContagionWorkshop.exe; missing tags now available

Thanks to everyone out there who's been patient with us (aw hell, and thanks to those who have not. Someone's got to keep us on our toes!) Now that we're all done with the eggnog, We've got a bunch of new, seasonally appropriate, potentially dangerous stuff brewing downstairs. We should have some more substantial updates coming soon!  

-The Contagion Team

[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-12-22_WinterSale/wintersale2015.png[/img]

[h1]Another winter, another winter sale![/h1]

 'Tis the season for wallet draining videogame deals. Contagion is 80% off, and as slick a deal as it's ever been with the Contagion and Soundtrack bundle. It's the feel-good deal of the season!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-12-22_WinterSale/contagionwintersale2015.png[/img][/url] 

[h1]Contagion Update![/h1]

On top of being a swell deal and an ideal gift as-is, we've got a winter themed update out the door and ready to play. We've also listened to your input from last time, so now there's an option to turn off the silly zombie attachments if that sort of thing just doesn't do it for you. We've got a sleighful of seasonally appropriate updates as well as a coal-bag's worth of not-so-festive content, but they are all worth celebrating none the less. Check out the whole list:
[list]
Flatline Beta Changes
	[*]Zombies walking speed now scales
		[list]
		[*]Waves 1-2 all zombies move slower
		[*]Waves 3-5 half of the zombies move fast
		[*]Waves 6-10 all zombies move fast
		[/list]
	[*]Slight nerf to number of overall zombies and riot zombies in each wave
	[*]Numerous map bug fixes
[/list]
[list]
Weapon Changes
	[*]Mossberg shotgun reworked to be good at wave clearing, but less effective damage versus single - targets such as riot zombies
	[*]Remington shotgun has great single target power but is weaker against wave clearing
	[*]Sig Sauer has improved accuracy
	[*]Fixed bug with Sig Sauer where your camera position could be misdirected to the side
[/list]
[list]
General Updates
	[*]Phone has improved default equipped view position so viewing the display is easier
	[*]Cockroach has improved running animations
	[*]Improved roach spectator camera functionality
[/list]
[list]
Xmas Holiday Update
	[*]New Client variable in = Options > Multiplayer > Show Holiday Extras
	[*]Default enabled, can be disabled if you are a scrooge and wish to turn off zombie xmas themed attachments
		[list]
		[*]Reindeer Headband
		[*]Glowing Rudolph Nose
		[*]Holiday Wreath
		[*]Santa Hat
		[/list]
	[*]All maps have been populated with holiday themed assets including snow covered textures and falling snow particles
[/list]

And screenshots! All the screenshots!
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-12-22_WinterSale/wintersaleshot01.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-12-22_WinterSale/wintersaleshot01_sm.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-12-22_WinterSale/wintersaleshot02.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-12-22_WinterSale/wintersaleshot02_sm.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-12-22_WinterSale/wintersaleshot03.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-12-22_WinterSale/wintersaleshot03_sm.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-12-22_WinterSale/wintersaleshot04.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-12-22_WinterSale/wintersaleshot04_sm.jpg[/img][/url]

Ok, truth time. That isnt all of the screenshots. There were a lot of them and it just wouldn't be practical to put them all here. So in lieu of posting an impossible amount of screenshots, I invite you all to play the game and see for yourself all the new stuff. It's better in person anyway.

Well, that's probably enough for now. All of us here at Monochrome hope you guys have a great winter holiday. We'll likely be toiling away the entire time making the game ever more better, so, as always, keep your eyes here for more updates!

notes.title: Game update, Flatline public beta avaliable now!
notes.notes:
Hello my favorite Contagion Fans!

[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015_12-11_Flatline_beta/flatline_beta.png[/img]

It’s taken its sweet time, and we know you all have been very patient with us. We're very happy to announce that we're finally ready to unleash the beast that is Flatline!

Just a recap in case you have not been privy to the details: Flatline is a Survivor only (no player zombies!), round based mode where you and 3 of your besties face wave after wave of zombies. Each successive wave will throw more and more zombies at you. But fear not, because after you complete a wave you will have access to better weapons, and sometimes items you need to gain access to more of the map. Places you will definitely need to be in order to ultimately make it out of there alive.

Do you die as often as I do? Problem solved! As long as at least one person survives, everyone will respawn when the wave ends. This will give you time to rearm and prepare for the next wave. If everyone dies... well, game over. Zombies win and take over the world. [strike]MAYBE I SHOULD BE BETTER AT VIDEOGAMES![/strike]

Ultimately, the goal is to survive to the final wave; a wave you surely cannot win. However, fortune smiles upon you and it looks like help is on the way. The question is, can you last long enough? Who knows! you'll have to play to find out.

And just a heads up, we're officially only supporting a max of 4 players in Flatline for now. We've seen some performance issues arise with larger numbers so until we get that optimized we're sticking with what's fun. Feel free to experiment with more players on your own servers, but be aware that there may be some issues involved with that for now.

The good news is the update should be going live as of the posting of this announcement. The servers have been updated (a little bit ahead of schedule, so sorry for anyone trying to get their Contagion on earlier today if you were having trouble connecting to an official server) and we'll have some Flatline only servers up and running very soon.

Here is a quasi-inclusive changelog:
[list]
[*] Flatline beta!
[*] numerous ce_montclair bug fixes
[*] new cockroach spectator mode, when you are near a survivor press USE and you can attach to their shoulder.
[*] remington870's red dot is now more realistic
[*] updates to a handful of existing props and materials
[*] optimization of lots of materials

notes.title: Game update, Flatline public beta avaliable now!
notes.notes:
Hello my favorite Contagion Fans!

[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015_12-11_Flatline_beta/flatline_beta.png[/img]

It’s taken its sweet time, and we know you all have been very patient with us. We're very happy to announce that we're finally ready to unleash the beast that is Flatline!

Just a recap in case you have not been privy to the details: Flatline is a Survivor only (no player zombies!), round based mode where you and 3 of your besties face wave after wave of zombies. Each successive wave will throw more and more zombies at you. But fear not, because after you complete a wave you will have access to better weapons, and sometimes items you need to gain access to more of the map. Places you will definitely need to be in order to ultimately make it out of there alive.

Do you die as often as I do? Problem solved! As long as at least one person survives, everyone will respawn when the wave ends. This will give you time to rearm and prepare for the next wave. If everyone dies... well, game over. Zombies win and take over the world. [strike]MAYBE I SHOULD BE BETTER AT VIDEOGAMES![/strike]

Ultimately, the goal is to survive to the final wave; a wave you surely cannot win. However, fortune smiles upon you and it looks like help is on the way. The question is, can you last long enough? Who knows! you'll have to play to find out.

And just a heads up, we're officially only supporting a max of 4 players in Flatline for now. We've seen some performance issues arise with larger numbers so until we get that optimized we're sticking with what's fun. Feel free to experiment with more players on your own servers, but be aware that there may be some issues involved with that for now.

The good news is the update should be going live as of the posting of this announcement. The servers have been updated (a little bit ahead of schedule, so sorry for anyone trying to get their Contagion on earlier today if you were having trouble connecting to an official server) and we'll have some Flatline only servers up and running very soon.

Here is a quasi-inclusive changelog:
[list]
[*] Flatline beta!
[*] numerous ce_montclair bug fixes
[*] new cockroach spectator mode, when you are near a survivor press USE and you can attach to their shoulder.
[*] remington870's red dot is now more realistic
[*] updates to a handful of existing props and materials
[*] optimization of lots of materials
[/list]

In the mean time, if you just cant wait for Steam to update Contagion, please check out the Flatline trailer:
[url=https://youtu.be/-sfXv-nBblw][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015_12-11_Flatline_beta/flatline_youtube.jpg[/img][/url]

We've also prepared a couple of new forums: Public Beta Discussion and Public Beta Bug Reports. Please direct your flatline discussion, issues, ideas and (hopefully not too many!) bug reports into the appropriate one of these two smoking hot, brand new, almost-still-in-the-wrapper forums.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/13/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015_12-11_Flatline_beta/beta_forums.png[/img][/url]

We hope you enjoy playing this as much as we had working on it (hopefully more!). Let us know what you think, and keep your eyes peeled for more updates soon.

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Post-Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Hello Contagion fans!

We hope you had a fun Halloween, hopefully filled with more treats than tricks. Over here on Team Contagion we have been hammering away on another update. The big one here is restoring the maps to their non-scary pre-Halloween versions, albeit with a handful of fixes sprinkled into them here and there.

We've also addressed a recent crashing issue that was brought to light by our newest map, Montclair. Although it seemed to be possible in any map, it was most prevalent there. The fix involved optimizing how zombies are removed (well, specifically, some zombies were not being removed when they should have been). If you have been having crashing issues ever since the last patch, you definitely want to check things out now.

Hunted has been slightly modified as well. Now when you ping another survivors phone, nearby zombies will be attracted to the sound. We're hoping this should spice up all things hunted a little bit, as we've been having a lot of fun with it. We've also increased the radius that your phone can "see" other player's phones to accommodate the play style of larger maps.

There's lots more coming down the pipe, so keep your eyes pealed for more updates!

Also, just for anyone who hasen't seen it yet, don't forget to check out the soundtrack:

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/407920][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-10-26_Halloween/Contagion_OST_Art_620.jpg[/img][/url]

The sale may be over, but it's still a pretty hot deal for $1.99 in my opinion. I know I am biased, but really, check it out if you like the music in the game. There's a lot of stuff in the soundtrack that isn't in the game (yet!), and its all very good music. Plus, it's got that fantastic track from the trailer! I've run the numbers, and it's statistically improbable for you to lose on this deal.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407920

Thanks again everyone, see you next time!

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Halloween hotfix!
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween!

Got a small hotfix coming out soon that should address a number of issues that came up with the recent patch. It wouldn't be game development if fixing one thing didn't break 3 more! Anyway, the important bits of the changelog is as follows:

- Added cvar to turn off pumpkins on zombies: allow_zombie_holiday. 0 for off and 1 for on. 1 is default for Halloween.
- fixed stealth melee kill bugs related to the zombie pumpkin heads
- numerous bugfixes and tweaks to ce_montclair
- fixed shortcut exploit in ce_barlowsquare


We know there are still a few more issues floating around but we are working hard to get them ironed out. In the mean time, we wanted to quickly get out an update with what we are able to fix now.

All of us at Monochrome hope that everyone has a great Halloween, and if you are going out trick-or-treating, going to a party, and/or participating in anything "cool" [ed. note: staying at home and playing videogames is cool, I don't care what anyone says], please stay safe and have fun!

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Summer Sale, DLC Release, and Intel Showcase!
notes.notes:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/2015_Contagion_Summer_Sale.jpg[/img][/url]

As everyone knows by now Steam is having it's yearly Summer Sale and they've got quite a bit of entertainment for us as well as some very sweet deals so do not miss out!

Contagion is on sale as well as the 4-Pack at 50% Off So check it out and share with your friends!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/Contagion_DLC.jpg[/img][/url]

But let's get to the real news regarding Contagion and that would be our Free DLC Bundle. After a poorly timed fiasco last year we've had to rebuild our team and learn from scratch quite a bit of work (please read our pinned thread on the details). This has delayed major releases including our Free DLC Bundle but we're tired of waiting and tired of making you guys wait.

While much of our content is linked due to the overhaul of the Source Engine and optimization as well as improved audio with Wwise we've managed to split the release into a few parts and will be delivering them asap starting today with our Map Release!

3 Gigabytes of Contagion Assets are currently being uploaded to Steam and in a few hours your copy of Contagion is going to either automatically start updating or ask that you update. We've been very busy even during the struggle that started last year and we believe modders will appreciate the ludicrous amount of content to work with and veteran players will notice significant improvements to existing environments. But today's release is focused on our MAP RELEASE with the below maps.

(We will be having all Official Servers Updated tomorrow)

https://youtu.be/NkpYVQGyWu0

[h1]Contagion DLC :: Map Release[/h1]

[b]CE_Harvest[/b]

[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ce_harvest_preview.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ce_harvest_preview_th.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]CE_CampWhitner :: CX_CampWhitner :: CH_CampWhitner[/b]

[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ce_campwhitner_preview.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ce_campwhitner_preview_th.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]CH_UnionStation[/b]

[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ch_unionstation_preview.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ch_unionstation_preview_th.jpg[/img][/url]

We will be releasing the new weapons, characters, and the new game-mode flatline as soon as these are ready or at least not as clumsy as they feel right now. The maps we've been having a blast on today making them release ready and will be reading your input as you play them. Modders will have much more content to work with and older maps have received some major polishing. Because there was soooo much work being done, so many devs being vetted, and confusion late last year and early this year there is no way to go over all the changes unfortunately but many veterans will notice the changes immediately to all existing content.

[url=https://appshowcase.intel.com/en-us/node/9188/revisions/11986][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/Intel_Logo_620.png[/img][/url]

Also wanted to share that we were invited and put on the Intel Showcase and have some other exciting news we hope we can share in the near future. That said, keep checking back on the next DLC release!

Someone asked us why we would waste our DLC during a Sale and lose the value behind marketing it. We told em we couldn't stand making you wait and that was costing us more.

Want to thank everyone for being so incredibly supportive and patient as we got our house in order. Looking forward to releasing content on a more regular basis once again.

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Free DLC Update Status and more!
notes.notes:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-04-22_DLC_Status/Free_DLC_Status_Header.png[/img][/url]

I want to first thank everyone for their patience and for those who are still wondering why it's taken as long as it has please review our General Discussion Pinned threads explaining much of the delays but not as in depth as I would like considering so many had to start from scratch without documented work to refer to which will not be an issue in the future.

[H1]Overview[/H1]
As many of you already know, Monochrome has repeatedly posted that all Contagion content including the larger DLC Bundles will be released free of charge for all those who own Contagion and that we're currently working on our first DLC bundle release.

For the sake of having a date set we are going to state April 30th, 2015 is our release date. We don't expect it to be delayed beyond this date (or I wouldn't have listed it) but will apologize in advance if any unforeseen circumstances (as it should be clear by now this isn't uncommon) were to push that date out a bit.

We are also requesting Valve schedule a Free Weekend with discount so that friends and family can experience the new content and potentially purchase it at a lower price.

[H1]What to expect from DLC[/H1]
[list]
[*]4 New Characters (includes their own unique voice actors)
[list]
[*] Mia
[*] Curtis
[*] Yumi
[*] Manuel
[/list]
[*]4 New Weapons
[list]
[*] Compound Bow (Actually trying to do some unique animations never done in source before but won't let it delay release if we can't sort it out before date)
[*] Remington 870
[*] M1 Garand
[*] SCAR
[/list]
[*] 2 New Maps
[list]
[*] Union Station
[*] Harvest
[/list]
[*] 1 New Game-Mode
[list]
[*] Flatline (Prefix CF_) which is a waved based survival game mode that will focus heavily on watching each others back, gathering resources, unlocking new areas, and saving your fellow survivors after they've been severely injured and will be the first game-mode we've released where there is no player zombies in the design.
[/list]
[/list]

[H1]Where we are on the status of each asset/mode[/H1]
[list]
[*] Characters
[list]
[*] All Characters are in-game each with their own unique voice actor and personality with the exception of Curtis who we are still working on voice for.
[/list]
[*] Weapons
[list]
[*] All 4 weapons are complete, in-game, with unique sounds and animations
[/list]
[*] Maps
[list]
[*] Both maps are complete with extensive playtesting but Union Station is being modified as we polish up Flatline.
[/list]
[*] Game-Mode
[list]
[*] Flatline is coming along nicely but we're still adjusting for balancing and testing as we didn't want to just fling a simple survival mode in there which can already be done by modders in other game-modes.
[/list]
[/list]

[H1]How confident are we about release[/H1]
We're actually quite confident but know if we run into an issue like we did with animations and how they were originally setup and the research time it took to sort out and implement the updated ones which we don't expect to happen but when including new content a lot of people are involved and the tinniest mistake can lead to delays. That said if I wasn't comfortable with April I wouldn't have stated that's the release month and now we have a day (if we release earlier... yay?).

[H1]What about the existing bugs and less than user friendly features?[/H1]
Many bug fixes are already included in this release like the local co-op cockroach glitch and we will definitely be implementing and polishing up new and existing features that will make playing Contagion easier and more enjoyable but many of these will be after this DLC Release.

[H1]What about Linux & Mac Platforms?[/H1]
We spent a great deal of money to make our version of the Engine Linux/Mac friendly but hit brickwall after brickwall even with the most experienced of programmers which is what happened with Valve and so while we can't release it on these platforms now we fully intend to put all our effort into moving to an updated version of Source (who knows what our options may be at that point) when it won't affect the majority of players. We have not forgotten our pledge to support these platforms.

[H1]Oh and btw...[/H1]
We already have a large map currently labelled camp that is nearly release ready for Escape, Extraction, and Hunted and another in the works. This map will expand on what we attempted to do in the past by including a unique story and possibly leading to something bigger for Contagion fans!

[H1]But you forgot...[/H1]
Sorry if I missed anything but it's likely already addressed in the Official Steam Contagion Community Hub so be sure to check it out and do a search if you don't see your question answered here.

[H1]OH DON'T FORGET TO SEND CONTAGION TO E3![/H1]
We could not delay the DLC by having our Team earn points for the Indie Crash E3 promo but by supporting and playing a slightly addictive web based game you can earn points for us to bring Contagion to E3 and increase our exposure which benefits the team and the community! Some members have well over 2billion points which means they alone are 1/15th of our total points and we're in the top 20 and going up in rank. If we had a handful of users do the same we would hit top 5 easy.

WANT TO HELP? THEN CLICK THE IMAGE BELOW AND SUPPORT US!
[url=http://indiescrashe3.com/nomination/21D2E0A6-6D1E-22E7-AD7C-DAFBBB068094][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/22/21237/thumb_620x2000/e3.jpg[/img][/url]

or click here - http://indiescrashe3.com/nomination/21D2E0A6-6D1E-22E7-AD7C-DAFBBB068094

ONLY 4-3 DAYS LEFT TO SHOW YOUR SUPPORT! Which is honestly with the help of a small small small percentage of our active community members more than enough time to get us there!

Want to once again thank everyone for all you've done for us over the years and we are still trying to repay the favor! Sorry it's taking us so long but we won't stop working away at making Contagion one of your favorite titles.

-The Contagion Team

I want to first thank everyone for their patience and for those who are still wondering why it's taken as long as it has please review our General Discussion Pinned threads explaining much of the delays but not as in depth as I would like considering so many had to start from scratch without documented work to refer to which will not be an issue in the future.

[H1]Overview[/H1]
As many of you already know, Monochrome has repeatedly posted that all Contagion content including the larger DLC Bundles will be released free of charge for all those who own Contagion and that we're currently working on our first DLC bundle release.

For the sake of having a date set we are going to state April 30th, 2015 is our release date. We don't expect it to be delayed beyond this date (or I wouldn't have listed it) but will apologize in advance if any unforeseen circumstances (as it should be clear by now this isn't uncommon) were to push that date out a bit.

We are also requesting Valve schedule a Free Weekend with discount so that friends and family can experience the new content and potentially purchase it at a lower price.

[H1]What to expect from DLC[/H1]
[list]
[*]4 New Characters (includes their own unique voice actors)
[list]
[*] Mia
[*] Curtis
[*] Yumi
[*] Manuel
[/list]
[*]4 New Weapons
[list]
[*] Compound Bow (Actually trying to do some unique animations never done in source before but won't let it delay release if we can't sort it out before date)
[*] Remington 870
[*] M1 Garand
[*] SCAR
[/list]
[*] 2 New Maps
[list]
[*] Union Station
[*] Harvest
[/list]
[*] 1 New Game-Mode
[list]
[*] Flatline (Prefix CF_) which is a waved based survival game mode that will focus heavily on watching each others back, gathering resources, unlocking new areas, and saving your fellow survivors after they've been severely injured and will be the first game-mode we've released where there is no player zombies in the design.
[/list]
[/list]

[H1]Where we are on the status of each asset/mode[/H1]
[list]
[*] Characters
[list]
[*] All Characters are in-game each with their own unique voice actor and personality with the exception of Curtis who we are still working on voice for.
[/list]
[*] Weapons
[list]
[*] All 4 weapons are complete, in-game, with unique sounds and animations
[/list]
[*] Maps
[list]
[*] Both maps are complete with extensive playtesting but Union Station is being modified as we polish up Flatline.
[/list]
[*] Game-Mode
[list]
[*] Flatline is coming along nicely but we're still adjusting for balancing and testing as we didn't want to just fling a simple survival mode in there which can already be done by modders in other game-modes.
[/list]
[/list]

[H1]How confident are we about release[/H1]
We're actually quite confident but know if we run into an issue like we did with animations and how they were originally setup and the research time it took to sort out and implement the updated ones which we don't expect to happen but when including new content a lot of people are involved and the tinniest mistake can lead to delays. That said if I wasn't comfortable with April I wouldn't have stated that's the release month and now we have a day (if we release earlier... yay?).

[H1]What about the existing bugs and less than user friendly features?[/H1]
Many bug fixes are already included in this release like the local co-op cockroach glitch and we will definitely be implementing and polishing up new and existing features that will make playing Contagion easier and more enjoyable but many of these will be after this DLC Release.

[H1]What about Linux & Mac Platforms?[/H1]
We spent a great deal of money to make our version of the Engine Linux/Mac friendly but hit brickwall after brickwall even with the most experienced of programmers which is what happened with Valve and so while we can't release it on these platforms now we fully intend to put all our effort into moving to an updated version of Source (who knows what our options may be at that point) when it won't affect the majority of players. We have not forgotten our pledge to support these platforms.

[H1]Oh and btw...[/H1]
We already have a large map currently labelled camp that is nearly release ready for Escape, Extraction, and Hunted and another in the works. This map will expand on what we attempted to do in the past by including a unique story and possibly leading to something bigger for Contagion fans!

[H1]But you forgot...[/H1]
Sorry if I missed anything but it's likely already addressed in the Official Steam Contagion Community Hub so be sure to check it out and do a search if you don't see your question answered here.

[H1]OH DON'T FORGET TO SEND CONTAGION TO E3![/H1]
We could not delay the DLC by having our Team earn points for the Indie Crash E3 promo but by supporting and playing a slightly addictive web based game you can earn points for us to bring Contagion to E3 and increase our exposure which benefits the team and the community! Some members have well over 2billion points which means they alone are 1/15th of our total points and we're in the top 20 and going up in rank. If we had a handful of users do the same we would hit top 5 easy.

WANT TO HELP? THEN CLICK THE IMAGE BELOW AND SUPPORT US!
[url=http://indiescrashe3.com/nomination/21D2E0A6-6D1E-22E7-AD7C-DAFBBB068094][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/22/21237/thumb_620x2000/e3.jpg[/img][/url]

or click here - http://indiescrashe3.com/nomination/21D2E0A6-6D1E-22E7-AD7C-DAFBBB068094

ONLY 4-3 DAYS LEFT TO SHOW YOUR SUPPORT! Which is honestly with the help of a small small small percentage of our active community members more than enough time to get us there!

Want to once again thank everyone for all you've done for us over the years and we are still trying to repay the favor! Sorry it's taking us so long but we won't stop working away at making Contagion one of your favorite titles.

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Latest Update with New Map & Web Comic "Break Down" Finale and More
notes.notes:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/Contagion_Store_Announcement_Preview.png[/img][/url]

As many of you already know we released our latest update while at the same time out in Florida setting up for ZombieFest which had 30,000 people. It was quite hectic and a few mistakes with updates but we got it out just in time to open the doors to the public. 

We did not have the time we wanted to prepare the map and walking around the area we just created for Contagion we were not content with the missing textures and assets the map deserved to really fill it out but the residents of Downtown Lakeland in no way felt the same and were quite overjoyed at being able to walk around a virtual representation of the area they grew up in having been hit by the zombie apocalypse.

Now that we've got a lot of pictures, videos, and media on it's way from hundreds out there in Florida (all will be put together for a media update soon) we have the material needed to update the map and open up some of the interiors with waivers being signed and sent our way so that we can do the map justice. That being said we have had to put Lakeland on hold to focus on finishing up our first Free DLC Bundle so the entire team has and is still working on that now but with Lakeland now up on Official Server's here are some screens the update's changelog.

[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-10-20_CH_Lakeland/CH_Lakeland01.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-10-20_CH_Lakeland/CH_Lakeland01_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-10-20_CH_Lakeland/CH_Lakeland02.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-10-20_CH_Lakeland/CH_Lakeland02_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-10-20_CH_Lakeland/CH_Lakeland03.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-10-20_CH_Lakeland/CH_Lakeland03_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-10-20_CH_Lakeland/CH_Lakeland04.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-10-20_CH_Lakeland/CH_Lakeland04_th.jpg[/img][/url]

[H1]Contagion - Update October 8th Changelog:[/H1]
[list]
[*] Added new map CH_Lakeland (Hunted Game-Mode) for ZombieFest sponsored by Monochrome LLC
[*] Added numerous assets for multiple maps
[*] Replaced old assets with newer & better versions
[*] Optimized, Fixed exploits, Bugs, and improved game-play for both Barlowe Square and Pioneer Express
[/list]

We've got more on the way and again our focus is our Free DLC (which no won't be here for Halloween which is something we would have like to have done but would have been a rushed job which we try to avoid whenever possible) but still hope to have something special out there for our favorite Holiday!

Also now that we're back we've got the finale of our Official Contagion Web Comic so have a look as next week we will reveal Volume 4 "Discord" and will return to weekly FridayFrenzy's ːbashː

[h1]Official Contagion Comic - Chapter 3 :: Week 11 - Finale[/h1]

[url=http://www.contagion-game.com/comicbook/][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/images/comicbook/chapters/contagion_breakdown_cover_620_preview.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.contagion-game.com/comicbook/][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/images/comicbook/previews/week23/cont_checking_out_wk23_steam.jpg[/img][/url]

We've got quite an exciting year to finish up and some incredible stuff to release. We have proven ourselves open to constructive criticism and will continue to stay involved with all of you to get your take on things as we progress. Updates will start to pick up shortly.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/site_images/contagion-now-on-steam.png[/img][/url]

Be on the lookout for more DLC Teasers as we've only barely hinted at what's to come.

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Sept 14th Update :: Significant Improvements, Update on Linux/Mac, and More
notes.notes:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/Contagion_Store_Announcement_Preview.png[/img][/url]

Today's update may seem smaller than it really is which has more to do with a great deal of work than the lack there of. Since our July 31st/August 1st release our focus has been on the Free 1st DLC Bundle and the Core Game Mechanics much of which is still being prototyped and tested for upcoming releases.

There hasn't been a single day of inactivity and we may have some additional surprises coming your way. Even with me flying back home to the States to save the Company additional expenses and get me on a timezone to better run things with Alex Wright (COO) I already have a powerful NoteBook to continue my work and everyone knows what they're do. I will also be making my first public appearance via a popular Talk Show on October 10th, Sponsoring and Running a Large Venue with 32 high end machines in the center of ZombieFest (with possible special guest appearance), and I think we might hit up Universal and/or DisneyWorld (never been to Florida) the day before we return.

Our Changelog is missing a considerable amount of AI Code, Optimization to Code, and further steps towards including the features we've mentioned such as an improved and much needed lobby system for those not wanting to go through the trouble of setting up a server which requires the usual Port Forwarding and more or 3rd Party Lan related software, New Animation System for our MoCap Animations, Ranking, Unlockables, Stats, and cosmetic options for players.

I will not see my family for some time as we sort Immigration which means I will be lost in my work. This year is going to be a very exciting year!

Check out today's Update (Including additions that didn't make it in the Build Changelog Text)-

[H1]Contagion - Update September 14th Changelog:[/H1]
[list]
[*] Added new triggers and challenges to Biotec
[*] Added new gates to CE_StoneCreek
[*] Added new sounds to improve atmosphere and immersion
[*] Improved Sound Zones
[*] Optimized AI Code
[*] Optimized Core Engine to boost Performance
[*] Optimized a significant number of assets to improve quality of game-play
[*] Optimized the following maps. CE_RoanokePD, CE_Biotec, CE_StoneCreek, and CE_BarloweSquare
[*] Significantly improved Zombie Pathing & Nav Mesh in CE_RoanokePD, 
CE_Biotec, CE_StoneCreek, and CE_BarloweSquare
[*] Removed dozens of Bugs, Exploits, and Glitches in CE_RoanokePD, 
CE_Biotec, CE_StoneCreek, and CE_BarloweSquare
[*] Removed obsolete Sounds and other Assets
[*] Rebuilt numerous Biotec and BarloweSquare Props to avoid issues with 
Players & AI
[*] Fixed a number of scripts for more accurate and improved game-play
[/list]

More updates coming and without the major delays!

Very soon we will be leaking more about the upcoming Free DLC as you may have caught some of that in the past. All 4 weapons are nearing release status, All 4 new characters are looking great (Manuel, Yumi, Mia, & Curtis), Both Maps again right on track, and Flatline is looking very promising. There are rumors of a release date and originally was planned for 3rd quarter but too many deaths, babies, and overhauls have led to delays. We have no doubt that we'll release before years end only our 1st Free DLC Bundle and we promised 2 but while we have an internal date we do not have a public ETA just yet.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-06-16_Update_Splitscreen/linux_mac_icon.png[/img][/url] I've mentioned this before but the Engine we're currently on has led to numerous brick walls when trying to do as something as simple as creating working Linux Binaries let alone Linux & Mac Platforms. It wasn't built for it but we have a few tricks up our sleeve to try and sort this out. If for any reason this does not pan out our only option is to update to a later Engine which considering the fact we gutted the original for the most part is not an easy task.

We are currently interviewing some of the best and brightest to either work it out or take up Valve's suggestion to move to a new Engine which will require some delicate coordination so that we can still update the existing Engine while building up on the new. No matter what happens our goal is to keep our promise and release on both Linux & Mac. We owe it to our fans but more importantly to those who made sure we hit that Stretch Goal! I rarely make promises so I never have to break em and I don't plan to break this one.

We highly recommend Linux and Mac users NOT purchase Contagion until this is sorted unless you're comfortable with Wine or Crossover.

Again I am flying back home and this will require a lot of effort to get setup with me passing my work to the team but not being as available as I've been with the community (I will do whatever I can to sort this out ASAP and maybe sooner than I expect). This includes our Weekly "Friday Frenzy" Twitch Stream & Giveaway. Some good news on that front is we've got an eager member of the team working out a SFM intro with a new music track specifically made for it when it will most definitely start back up and may even return with DLC in mind! For now please enjoy the latest Episode 31 (check out any else you missed as well as Contagious Gaming Playlist)!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=49UHj7P1jUk

Expect a pretty epic year! Wish me a safe flight(s) and remember just cause I may not be around for a bit the team is still working day & night and your support has always kept us moving steadily forward!

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Biotec, Stone Creek, and more in July Update!
notes.notes:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/Contagion_Store_Announcement_Preview.png[/img][/url]

As promised we've released our much anticipated Zombie Panic: Source Biotec Remake (Escape & Hunted Game-Modes), Stone Creek (Escape Game-Mode but in many ways Survival gameplay) the most popular Workshop map now in our Official rotation, our new Melee System that is not only much more user friendly but now with bladed weapons can more than cut off limbs but now decapitate zombies as well!

Of course we updated all existing maps with improvements, optimization, bug fixes, and exploits being removed.

Here is a look at these new maps!

[h1]Contagion - Biotec[/h1]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec01.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec01_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec02.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec02_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec03.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec03_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec04.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec04_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec05.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec05_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec06.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec06_th.jpg[/img][/url]

Once again seek out the experimental vaccine that may hold the key humanities very survival! But it would seem that Biotec security was unable to either handle the horde invading... or was it from within?

[h1]Contagion - Stone Creek[/h1]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek01.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek01_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek02.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek02_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek03.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek03_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek04.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek04_th.jpg[/img][/url]

With the most subscribers on Workshop and our promise to bring the communities favorites into the Official rotation (with permission of author) we're happy to include the very claustrophobic, classic survival like Escape map "Stone Creek" in our Official list of maps!

Check out what went out in our July update!

[h1]July 31st Update - Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new map Biotec (Escape & Hunted Game-Modes)
[*] Added new map by popularity from Workshop Stone Creek (Escape Game-Mode)
[*] Added gasmask objective item that prevents harmful chemicals from affecting player
[*] Added gasmask voice muffling for survivors
[*] Added Keycard objective item for unlocking security doors
[*] Added keycard entity system for mappers
[*] Added Zombie Decapitation with bladed weapons (Kabar not included)
[*] Updated Melee System (WIP for balance) with decapitation
[*] Improved navigation mesh for all existing maps
[*] Changes to networking system in an attempt to fix LAN related issues
[*] Kill Cam with the above mentioned bladed weapons also decapitate zombies when using stealth kill
[*] Fixed weapon holstering issues
[*] Fixed exploits, issues, and bugs on all maps from bug reports by the community (Thank you!)
[/list]

If you missed our IndieDB "Monday Night Indie" with our good friend Dave "Henl3y" Traeger where we got to once again Stream together but this time with our game Contagion check it out!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GD0RW1DKl4E

Also don't forget tomorrow at 7:30PM PST/PDT (GMT - 7:00) we will be returning to our weekly "Friday Frenzy" Stream & Giveaway where we will be playing... Biotec of course! Be sure to be there and follow us on our channel http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0

[url=http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2013_09_13_Kickstarter/TwitchTV_450.png[/img][/url]

We stream our Official Contagion "Friday Frenzy" and/or "Contagious Gaming" via our Twitch.Tv Account at- http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0 every Friday @ 7:30PM PST/PDT (GMT- 7:00) [url=http://wwp.greenwichmeantime.com/time-zone/usa/pacific-time/]-Click here for current time-[/url] and will pass out one or more free copies of Contagion during the Stream!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/site_images/contagion-now-on-steam.png[/img][/url]

Our Free DLC is in the works and coming along nicely and again will include 4 New Characters, 4 New Weapons, 2 New Maps, and 1 new game-mode. There will be other updates before and after as well as a second Free DLC bundle with amount of content not too long after but this in no way impedes our ability to further optimize and improve our game.

He're a look at what we're working on atm [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/558752451170175902/]-Here-[/url]

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Update June 16th :: Split Screen Local Co-op, AI tweaks, Linux/Mac Update, and much more!
notes.notes:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2013_09_13_Kickstarter/Contagion_Logo_450.png[/img][/url]

It's been a long time coming for many but we've finally added Local Co-op Split-screen without the need like other games to go through a series of steps to get it working right. 2 Game-pads, Keyboard & Mouse & Game-pad, the days of Consoles and PC games lacking this feature may be dying out but this is something we grew up with and playing with a friend or sibling without having to lan was a hot topic for gamers and owners of Contagion so we can now tick our Local Co-op in the listings. We will continue to watch over it and tweak here and there to improve the overall quality of course (no aim assist for game-pads, sorry heh).

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-06-16_Update_Splitscreen/Contagion_Local_Coop_Splitscreen.jpg[/img][/url]

Our Survivor AI accuracy is dependent on difficulty as well as commands that are allowed making Extraction while it was still difficult, more realistic and this will only improve throughout the year.

We've also enabled more server commands for Server Hosts to use to setup their servers closer to what they'd like them to be (Dec went to bed and I don't have the list heh)

Check out the changes below in this weeks update-

[h1]Contagion - Update June 16th Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added split-screen support to Contagion, also added menu in options to enable it. (WIP)
[*] Adjusted survivor AI accuracy to be less perfect on easier difficulties.
[*] Enabled additional console commands to be allowed to be changed by server hosts.
[*] Fixed the ability to drop a grenade before infection and kill ex-teammates.
[*] Fixed survivor AI being able to receive commands while inside a house or while climbing.
[*] Fixed IED and phone screen disappearing near water or mirror elements sometimes.
[*] Fixed memory leak issues with multiple flash-lights.
[*] Fixed possible server crash-loop when blending as a zombie.
[/list]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-06-16_Update_Splitscreen/linux_mac_icon.png[/img][/url] This week we have updates on both Linux and the Mac build. Valve has been quite helpful in keeping on things an we have started working not only on our Linux but also our Mac builds! Whether they are able to release simultaneously or not is yet to be seen but this is great news to those who are eager to play Contagion on their Linux machine/Steam Machine and/or Mac!

Also for those that missed our Official Contagion - Let's Play Top 10 Countdown with prizes exceeding $12,500 check it out!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOyyfFzsE5g

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/site_images/contagion-now-on-steam.png[/img][/url]

Next week we're hoping to release our updated melee system that will definitely change the way the game is played and for many this is also another update that's been eagerly awaited. Will also try and grab some sneak peaks of our current maps in development/nearing release like CE_Biotec :)

He're a look at what we're working on atm - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/558752451170175902/]-Here-[/url]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/steam.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.facebook.com/contagion.game][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/facebook.png[/img][/url] [url=https://twitter.com/contagion_game][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/twitter.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.youtube.com/PlayContagion][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/youtube.png[/img][/url] [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/contagion][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/indiedb.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Contagion - Update June 4th :: Crossbow deadlier than ever, Linux Update, and 9 Ways Contagion Brings the Zombie Genre Back From the Dead!
notes.notes:
I apologize for the delay in announcing a release that went out nearly 12 hours ago but sometimes this is a good sign and in our case and for the future of Contagion it is! We hope you approve of the weekly updates and will be releasing more content shortly and more often very soon!
[h1]9 Ways Contagion Brings the Zombie Genre Back From the Dead :: Game Cupid[/h1] [quote]“Oh great! Another generic zombie game!” I hear you say. Stop rolling your eyes a second and hear me out.[/quote] We can't help but get a jump start when Contagion goes from a generic Zombie game to a "Oh" moment and the hard work, design, and depth of the game just clicks for users. No hand holding, but a well thought out and challenging game that attempts to hit the mark but only time will tell. Check out the full review at [url=http://www.gamecupid.com/content/feature-game-contagion]GameCupid.com[/url] [h1]Where we are at with Linux (Linux Update as promised)[/h1] Linux progresses and we're quite confident that we'll soon be able to release our Linux and Mac platforms soon but as we said last week there are walls and the latest one is an issue with networking on Valve's end. Will keep you up to date but have made vast steps forward since the last update. Here is what we put out in today's patch [h1]June 4th Update - Changelog:[/h1] [list] [*] Added 'you are here' maps around Barlowe to help navigation. [*] Added glow symbol underneath infected survivors when seen through zombie vision. [*] Added additional checks to try solve invisible survivor glitch. [*] Improved many areas on Barlowe square and fixed lots of exploited areas. [*] Riot zombies in Panic gamemodes can now cause infection with claws but not with grapple bite. [*] Bigger penalty in Hunted for suicide and new penalty for drawing a round. [*] Many navmesh fixes to Barlowe Square to help with Extraction. [*] Fixed zombies disappearing when killed instead of seeing a corpse. [*] Adjustments to crossbow accuracy and power. [*] Adjusted GPS in Barlowe Extraction to not be so bright. [*] Adjusted delay after grapple that zombies can hit survivors. [*] Adjusted microphone drawing in Panic gamemodes scoreboard. [*] Adjusted 16 player scoreboard to change to 16 slot layout when number of players goes above 8. [*] Adjusted character breathing sounds when running out of stamina. [*] Fixed ability for some weapons to do large friendly fire on Normal difficulty. [*] Fixed ability to join a Hunted game as a survivor in the last remaining minutes. [*] Fixed pathing entities causing navigation issues on Barlowe. [*] Removed per-difficulty damage adjustment for Grenades. [/list] Due to the hours and sleep deprivation and so I can focus on getting new content out like CE_Biotec ASAP, Joe is stepping in handle our General Discussion. Please be gentle! We will still be watching over and helping those in need however!
He're a look at what we're working on atm - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/558752451170175902/]-Here-[/url] -The Contagion Team

We will have updates on new zombies, characters, maps, possibly weapons, and more next month but this month we have another update going out early next week (holidays in my way!) that will boost performance and fix a number of exploits and other issues and maybe a bit more. We should have an update at the end of the month regarding Linux progress (which will lead to a Mac news update in the near future as well). Today we will be handing out 2 extra keys a total of 5 as I jump into some updated Workshop Maps that members have requested I check out! While you wait for the stream to start in 30mins check out the newly uploaded "Friday Frenzy" Youtube episodes 23 & 24! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HEYd22nZ5PE&feature=youtu.be https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bz6svEU2cY4&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: Contagion - Update May 18th :: Increased Player Slots, New SDK/Workshop, and Linux?
notes.notes:
Today's update was a blast but means a bit more work for us as we've been keeping busy (wait for the gasmask). We no longer have an in-game workshop publishing tool due to the limitations it set. We've updated our ContagionSDK to include our Workshop Publishing Tool which now allows what it couldn't before the option to review your screenshot, update existing addons, update details of addons, and all a modders could hope for. We can add to this later thanks to the setup as well.
With the new PANIC modes we had been testing 16 players using bots. But because we could never get enough ppl together in team due to our small numbers we put it out there and testing was a huge success! Both Hunted and our Panic Game-Modes support 16 players (our Escape and Extraction game modes do not at this time) and we've got our Official Contagion Gameservers Servers running 16 slots right now (Their is maintenance being done over at GS so there may be stragglers which we'll go over)! Gameservers has updated their options from 8 slots to now being able to rent between 8 and 16 slots.
This is going to require balancing and don't worry the HUD is temporary! Replacements coming soon.
Also for those who've been patiently been sitting around we want you to know that we will have an update regarding Linux at the end of the month. Michael Brune is working hard solely on the release of both the Server Binaries and Platform! (More on Mac asap!) [h1]May 18th Update - Changelog:[/h1] [list] [*] Added Hunted and both Panic game-modes the ability to play up to 16 players now [*] Added Contagion Workshop Manager to the ContagionSDK. Removed in-game add-on publisher for favour of better software [*] Added ability for mappers to set different spawn weapons for survivors [*] Tweaked HUD elements to support 16 players on those servers [*] Fixed riot-zombie having female legs for those who picked a female character [*] Fixed issue with first-person hands movement 'lagging' when in dedicated servers [*] Fixes to Barlowe Square nav-mesh, fenced areas and fixed some camping spots [/list] Remember more updates this month and major updates every month of 2014 so keep checking in for more info!
He're a look at what we're working on atm - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/558752451170175902/]-Here-[/url] -The Contagion Team
